judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the Definition of Done, an acceptance test, and a spec update, without actually implementing the fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the `error instanceof Error` gate was never removed from `chatOrchestrator.ts`, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` runs. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the acceptance criterion requiring a `CHANGELOG.md` update, and left an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file in the working tree.
